Research
Evidence Synthesis & Research Methodology
Systematic reviews, meta-analyses and methodological research focused on improving the quality, reliability and usefulness of biomedical evidence.
Animal Welfare & Translational Research
Animal models, experimental validity, reproducibility and the translation of preclinical findings into human health research.
Research Integrity & Reproducibility
Bias, questionable research practices, open science, reproducible workflows and FAIR research principles.
Biomedical & Real-World Data
Statistical analysis and data science applied to clinical and preclinical datasets, including real-world ophthalmology and clinical trial data.
Computational Research & Scientific Communication
Data pipelines, interactive dashboards, data visualisation and automated workflows that make complex scientific evidence easier to explore, understand and communicate.
